rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides AI assistants with complete access to Bugcrowd's bug bounty platform API, built using Python with FastMCP and httpx for async HTTP operations. The implementation offers 30+ tools across eight core categories: access invitation management, customer asset CRUD operations, organization administration, program listing and retrieval, vulnerability report handling with creation/update capabilities, submission management for bug bounty reports, activity tracking, and authentication/authorization logging. Built with Token-based authentication, comprehensive error handling, and support for both full updates via PATCH and resource deletion across all endpoints, it serves security teams managing bug bounty programs through conversational interfaces, researchers needing natural language access to platform data, and security operations workflows where AI-driven vulnerability management enhances productivity without direct API integration knowledge.
